name: STELLAR
source:
"Who are you?"

Journey throughout the universe to learn about various cultures and creatures, witness cosmic events, and learn what the universe holds.

[From [url=https://eontail.itch.io/stellar]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
「你是誰？」

遨遊宇宙，認識形形色色的文化與生靈，親眼見證宇宙中的大事，瞭解這片宇宙究竟藏著什麼。
